summary: Famed London club and promoter Fabric has revealed a four-year partnership with the city’s St Paul’s Cathedral to promote contemporary live music events in the heritage site. title: NSW to bring official drug checking to 15 festivals from this year
summary: The New South Wales (NSW) government has announced a AUS$4.3m investment in official drug checking services at up to 15 music festivals, which will begin in October 2026. Drug checking refers to a system of on-site testing centres at concerts and festivals where event attendees can submit samples of substances to be tested for safety before consumption. The NSW government emphasised that illicit drugs remain illegal, but that users’ identities will not be shared with law enforcement under the scheme.
